correctness.rationale: For rational affine points of the Asgarli–Ghioca F_k plane-filling pencil over odd F_q, differentiating at F_q coordinates yields 1+ka²−a²b=0, a³−b²=0, and a dependent third equation; a,b nonzero and t=b/a uniquely give (a,b,k)=(t²,t³,t³−t^−4). Infinity has no rational singularity. The quadratic tangent cone has discriminant 4t(t^7−4); nonzero gives a node and its square/nonsquare decides split branches, zero gives the unique double tangent whose transverse cubic coefficient (1/2)t^−4 is nonzero, including q=3 after Frobenius cubic cancellation. The character-sum count over t∈F_q* yields q−1 incidences and node/split/cusp formulas; if 7∤q−1, w=t^7 is a bijection and quadratic sum S=−1; if 7|q−1, the even-degree hyperelliptic H:v²=u(u^7−4) is genus 3 with two infinity points. The cusp parameter equation 256k^7=3^7 handles characteristic 3 separately. Independent direct derivative/projective-boundary and F_p counts for p=3,5,7,11,13 matched. No claims for extension-field singularities.
